experiment.name: cgc-rf-locked-test-v1
experiment.role: single-release threshold-free held-out simulation test of frozen clock-centered multipath-versus-spoof discrimination
experiment.execution_policy: one deterministic release and one analysis on test pairs 010--012; no score, estimator, aggregation, seed, gate, or exclusion changes after any test signal or metric access
experiment.runner_implementation_rule: the runner must be implemented, reviewed against this config, and committed before any test signal is generated or opened

negative_absolute_threshold_audit.interpretation: the absolute threshold failed train geometry transfer and is forbidden in this locked test

frozen_candidate.primary_separation: multipath median residual minus spoof median residual; positive means spoof has the higher detection score

data_boundary.validation_partition_role: not evidence for this post-hoc candidate because it was previously inspected
data_boundary.test_release_condition: the protocol/config commit and the conforming runner commit must both exist before first test signal access

source_generation.generation_law: use the pinned paired train generator's signal, gain, front-end, receiver-seed, and AWGN laws without parameter fitting, restricted to the three frozen test rows
source_generation.pairing_contract: normal and spoof share authentic component, time, position or trajectory, receiver seed, receiver impairments, front-end gain, and pre-onset samples; only the counterfeit component and its power/trajectory envelope vary
source_generation.test_source_manifest_policy: manifests and hashes are created and recorded only after the protocol and conforming runner are committed; they may not be used to change this config

multipath.prn_policy: all valid GPS PRNs present in the frozen authentic startup LOS table
multipath.phase_policy: SHA-256-derived independent uniform phase in [-180,180) degrees
multipath.trajectory_policy: reuse the exact authentic test-pair trajectory and recorded trajectory hash; static pairs remain static

analysis.comparison_start_policy: spoof start + max(transition, power ramp) + 1 second
analysis.primary_unit: pair-level scenario median; one multipath residual and one spoof residual per pair
analysis.primary_endpoint: three pair-level clock-centered separations and their pair-block AUC
analysis.legacy_endpoint: the same pair-level calculation with the frozen zero-referenced residual, used only for the preregistered centered-versus-legacy support gate
analysis.bin_level_metrics: secondary descriptive only because one-second bins within a run are serially dependent
analysis.normal_stream_use: generation/provenance only; normal scores cannot fit a threshold, calibrate the candidate, exclude a pair, or enter the primary endpoint

evaluation.decision_rule: SUPPORTED only if every support gate passes; otherwise NOT SUPPORTED

claim_boundary: held-out simulated receiver-RF evidence for relative multipath-versus-carry-off-spoof discrimination only; no absolute detector threshold, field false-alarm, TEXBAT, operational, or WCL generalization claim
